packs.title: Git safety
packs.description: Block git commands that throw away uncommitted work or rewrite history.
packs.fail_message: Your organization's coding agent policy blocks git commands that discard uncommitted work or rewrite history (reset --hard, push --force, clean -f, checkout --, stash drop or clear, branch -D).

packs.title: Destructive commands
packs.description: Block recursive deletes such as rm -rf across shell tools.
packs.fail_message: Your organization's coding agent policy blocks recursive deletes such as rm -rf.

packs.title: Permissions
packs.description: Block recursive chmod/chown and chmod 777 on / or $HOME.
packs.fail_message: Your organization's coding agent policy blocks recursive chmod or chown, and chmod 777, on / or the home directory.

packs.title: Disk wipe
packs.description: Block irreversible disk operations: dd to devices, mkfs, wipefs, fdisk, and parted.
packs.fail_message: Your organization's coding agent policy blocks irreversible disk operations: dd to a device, mkfs, wipefs, fdisk, and parted.

packs.title: File safety
packs.description: Block reading and writing .env files across file and shell tools.
packs.fail_message: Your organization's coding agent policy blocks reading or writing .env files.
